name: dynein axonemal heavy chain 11

function.text: DNAH11 encodes dynein axonemal heavy chain 11. Annotated molecular activities include minus-end-directed microtubule motor activity and dynein intermediate chain binding. It participates in flagellated sperm motility and determination of left/right symmetry.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to primary ciliary dyskinesia 7 (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: The gene appears in specialty educational coverage, but a disease-specific somatic driver relationship has not been assigned in this draft; expression-marker or assay-context mentions are not mutation evidence.

function.text: DNAH11 encodes dynein axonemal heavy chain 11. Based in part on similarity, it produces force towards the minus ends of microtubules. It is a key component of dynein, a family of motor proteins essential for movement along microtubules. It is required for structural and functional integrity of cilia.

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with primary ciliary dyskinesia 7 (autosomal recessive).
